card.name: Dosage form after drug name
card.fires_on: The dosage-form word (capsules, cream, ointment, emulsion) or its inner pieces right after a drug name in label text. Also fires on a few partway-through spots in technical words like sublimation.

modes.label: Dosage form after drug name
modes.description: The form word such as capsules or cream, or a piece of ointment or emulsion, follows a drug name.
modes.example: Do not open fluvastatin<< capsules>> prior to administration

modes.label: Inside technical words
modes.description: A middle piece of a science term or a drug name that is still unfinished.

card.writes: It favors word pieces that continue a word such as artic, inter, punct or med, and disfavors 'or' and slash.
card.plain: It marks the spot where a drug's form, like capsules or ointment, is named right after the drug name.
evidence: Do not open fluvastatin<< capsules>> prior to administration
